passages.text: Concerning Moab, this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo, for it will be devastated. Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced; the fortress will be shattered and dismantled.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD of Hosts speaks about Moab.
The LORD says, “Woe to Nebo.
Nebo will be devastated.
Kiriathaim will be captured.
Kiriathaim will be disgraced.
The fortress will be shattered.
The fortress will be dismantled.”
passages.original: לְמוֹאָ֡ב כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וֹי אֶל־ נְבוֹ֙ כִּ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔דָה הֹבִ֥ישָׁה נִלְכְּדָ֖ה קִרְיָתָ֑יִם הֹבִ֥ישָׁה הַמִּשְׂגָּ֖ב וָחָֽתָּה׃

passages.text: There is no longer praise for Moab; in Heshbon they devise evil against her: ‘Come, let us cut her off from nationhood.’ You too, O people of Madmen, will be silenced; the sword will pursue you.
passages.sermon:
Moab was a nation.
People no longer praise Moab.
Heshbon is a city.
In Heshbon, people plan evil against Moab.
They say, “Come, let us destroy Moab as a nation.”
Madmen is another city.
People in Madmen will also be silenced.
A sword will chase the people of Madmen.
passages.original: אֵ֣ין עוֹד֮ תְּהִלַּ֣ת מוֹאָב֒ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן חָשְׁב֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ רָעָ֔ה לְכ֖וּ וְנַכְרִיתֶ֣נָּה מִגּ֑וֹי גַּם־ מַדְמֵ֣ן תִּדֹּ֔מִּי אַחֲרַ֖יִךְ תֵּ֥לֶךְ חָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: A voice cries out from Horonaim: ‘Devastation and great destruction!’
passages.sermon:
A voice comes from Horonaim.
The voice cries out loudly.
There is devastation in Horonaim.
There is great destruction in Horonaim.
passages.original: ק֥וֹל צְעָקָ֖ה מֵחֹֽרוֹנָ֑יִם שֹׁ֖ד וָשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃

passages.text: Moab will be shattered; her little ones will cry out.
passages.sermon: Moab is a nation.\r\nGod will shatter Moab.\r\nThe children of Moab will cry out.
passages.original: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה מוֹאָ֑ב הִשְׁמִ֥יעוּ זְּעָקָ֖ה צְעוֹרֶיהָ׃

passages.text: For on the ascent to Luhith they weep bitterly as they go, and on the descent to Horonaim cries of distress resound over the destruction: ‘Flee! Run for your lives! Become like a juniper in the desert.’
passages.sermon:
The people of Moab are in great distress.
They climb the ascent to Luhith.
They weep bitterly as they go up.
They descend toward Horonaim.
They hear cries of distress because of destruction.
People shout warnings.
They say, "Flee!"
They say, "Run for your lives!"
They say, "Become like a juniper in the desert."
A juniper in the desert stands alone and exposed.
The people must escape quickly.
They must leave everything behind to survive.
passages.original: כִּ֚י מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַלֻּחוֹת בִּבְכִ֖י יַֽעֲלֶה־ בֶּ֑כִי כִּ֚י בְּמוֹרַ֣ד חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם צָרֵ֥י צַֽעֲקַת־ שֶׁ֖בֶר שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ נֻ֖סוּ מַלְּט֣וּ נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וְתִֽהְיֶ֕ינָה כַּעֲרוֹעֵ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: Because you trust in your works and treasures, you too will be captured, and Chemosh will go into exile with his priests and officials.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab trusts in her own works.
Moab trusts in her treasures.
Because of this trust, Moab will be captured.
Chemosh is the god of Moab.
Chemosh will go into exile.
Chemosh’s priests will go into exile.
Chemosh’s officials will go into exile.
They will all go together.
passages.original: כִּ֠י יַ֣עַן בִּטְחֵ֤ךְ בְּמַעֲשַׂ֙יִךְ֙ וּבְא֣וֹצְרוֹתַ֔יִךְ גַּם־ אַ֖תְּ תִּלָּכֵ֑דִי וְיָצָ֤א כְמִישׁ בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה כֹּהֲנָ֥יו וְשָׂרָ֖יו יַחַד׃

passages.text: The destroyer will move against every city, and not one town will escape. The valley will also be ruined, and the high plain will be destroyed, as the LORD has said.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke these words.
A destroyer will come.
He will attack every city.
No town will escape.
The valley will be ruined.
The high plain will be destroyed.
passages.original: וְיָבֹ֨א שֹׁדֵ֜ד אֶל־ כָּל־ עִ֗יר וְעִיר֙ לֹ֣א תִמָּלֵ֔ט וְאָבַ֥ד הָעֵ֖מֶק וְנִשְׁמַ֣ד הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste; her cities will become desolate, with no one to dwell in them.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab will be destroyed.
Scatter salt on Moab.
Moab will become a wasteland.
Her cities will become empty.
No one will live in her cities.
passages.original: תְּנוּ־ צִ֣יץ לְמוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י נָצֹ֖א תֵּצֵ֑א וְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ינָה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: Cursed is the one who is remiss in doing the work of the LORD, and cursed is he who withholds his sword from bloodshed.
passages.sermon:
God gives a command.
God expects people to do His work faithfully.
A person who does the LORD’s work carelessly is cursed.
A person who holds back his sword from bloodshed is also cursed.
God wants His work done with full effort and obedience.
passages.original: אָר֗וּר עֹשֶׂ֛ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת יְהוָ֖ה רְמִיָּ֑ה וְאָר֕וּר מֹנֵ֥עַ חַרְבּ֖וֹ מִדָּֽם׃

passages.text: Moab has been at ease from youth, settled like wine on its dregs; he has not been poured from vessel to vessel or gone into exile. So his flavor has remained the same, and his aroma is unchanged.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab has lived in comfort since its youth.
Moab has not faced trouble or hardship.
Moab is like wine that sits undisturbed on its dregs.
No one has poured Moab from one vessel to another.
Moab has not gone into exile.
Moab has not been shaken or changed.
Moab’s flavor has stayed the same.
Moab’s aroma has not changed.
passages.original: שַׁאֲנַ֨ן מוֹאָ֜ב מִנְּעוּרָ֗יו וְשֹׁקֵ֥ט הוּא֙ אֶל־ שְׁמָרָ֔יו וְלֹֽא־ הוּרַ֤ק מִכְּלִי֙ אֶל־ כֶּ֔לִי וּבַגּוֹלָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן עָמַ֤ד טַעְמוֹ֙ בּ֔וֹ וְרֵיח֖וֹ לֹ֥א נָמָֽר׃ס

passages.text: Therefore behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will send to him wanderers, who will pour him out. They will empty his vessels and shatter his jars.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD says, “Days are coming.”
The LORD will act in these days.
The LORD will send wanderers to Moab.
These wanderers will pour Moab out.
They will empty Moab’s vessels.
They will shatter Moab’s jars.
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּ֖ה־ יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ ל֥וֹ צֹעִ֖ים וְצֵעֻ֑הוּ וְכֵלָ֣יו יָרִ֔יקוּ וְנִבְלֵיהֶ֖ם יְנַפֵּֽצוּ׃

passages.text: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Chemosh is the god of Moab.
Moab will feel shame because of Chemosh.
The house of Israel is the people of Israel.
The people of Israel once trusted in Bethel.
The people of Israel felt shame because of Bethel.
Moab will feel shame in the same way Israel felt shame.
passages.original: וּבֹ֥שׁ מוֹאָ֖ב מִכְּמ֑וֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ בֹּ֙שׁוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֵּ֥ית אֵ֖ל מִבְטֶחָֽם׃

passages.text: How can you say, ‘We are warriors, mighty men ready for battle’?
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab’s people claim to be strong.
They say, “We are warriors.”
They say, “We are mighty men.”
They say, “We are ready for battle.”
How can you say these things?
passages.original: אֵ֚יךְ תֹּֽאמְר֔וּ גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְאַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: Moab has been destroyed and its towns have been invaded; the best of its young men have gone down in the slaughter, declares the King, whose name is the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the King.
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
Moab has been destroyed.
Enemies have invaded Moab’s towns.
The best young men of Moab have died in the slaughter.
passages.original: שֻׁדַּ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ וְעָרֶ֣יהָ עָלָ֔ה וּמִבְחַ֥ר בַּֽחוּרָ֖יו יָרְד֣וּ לַטָּ֑בַח נְאֻ֨ם־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Moab’s calamity is at hand, and his affliction is rushing swiftly.
passages.sermon: Moab faces disaster soon.\r\nTrouble comes to Moab quickly.\r\nMoab’s suffering approaches fast.
passages.original: קָר֥וֹב אֵיד־ מוֹאָ֖ב לָב֑וֹא וְרָ֣עָת֔וֹ מִהֲרָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Mourn for him, all you who surround him, everyone who knows his name; tell how the mighty scepter is shattered— the glorious staff!
passages.sermon:
Moab was a nation.
Moab was powerful.
Moab is now destroyed.
People lived around Moab.
Some people knew Moab’s name.
All who surround Moab, mourn for him.
Everyone who knows Moab’s name, mourn for him.
Say this: The strong scepter is broken.
The glorious staff is shattered.
passages.original: נֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ כָּל־ סְבִיבָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל יֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ אִמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֤ה נִשְׁבַּר֙ מַטֵּה־ עֹ֔ז מַקֵּ֖ל תִּפְאָרָֽה׃

passages.text: Come down from your glory; sit on parched ground, O daughter dwelling in Dibon, for the destroyer of Moab has come against you; he has destroyed your fortresses.
passages.sermon:
The people of Dibon are proud.
They live in comfort and honor.
God tells them to leave their high position.
He tells them to come down from their glory.
He tells them to sit on dry, thirsty ground.
The destroyer of Moab has come against them.
He has destroyed their strongholds.
Their safety is gone.
Their protection is broken.
passages.original: רְדִ֤י מִכָּבוֹד֙ יֹשְׁבֶי בַצָּמָ֔א יֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־ דִּיב֑וֹן כִּֽי־ שֹׁדֵ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ עָ֣לָה בָ֔ךְ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: Stand by the road and watch, O dweller of Aroer! Ask the man fleeing or the woman escaping, ‘What has happened?’
passages.sermon:
The people of Moab face destruction.
You live in Aroer.
Stand by the road.
Watch what is happening.
See the people who are running away.
See the people who are escaping.
Ask them, “What has happened?”
passages.original: אֶל־ דֶּ֛רֶךְ עִמְדִ֥י וְצַפִּ֖י יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת עֲרוֹעֵ֑ר שַׁאֲלִי־ נָ֣ס וְנִמְלָ֔טָה אִמְרִ֖י מַה־ נִּֽהְיָֽתָה׃

passages.text: Moab is put to shame, for it has been shattered. Wail and cry out! Declare by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab is put to shame.
Moab has been shattered.
People, wail.
People, cry out.
Announce this news by the Arnon River.
Moab is destroyed.
passages.original: הֹבִ֥ישׁ מוֹאָ֛ב כִּֽי־ חַ֖תָּה הֵילִילִי וּזְעָקִי הַגִּ֣ידוּ בְאַרְנ֔וֹן כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד מוֹאָֽב׃

passages.text: Judgment has come upon the high plain— upon Holon, Jahzah, and Mephaath, upon Dibon, Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim, upon Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon, upon Kerioth, Bozrah, and all the towns of Moab, those far and near.
passages.sermon:
God brings judgment.
He sends judgment to the land of Moab.
The judgment reaches the high plain.
It comes to Holon.
It comes to Jahzah.
It comes to Mephaath.
It comes to Dibon.
It comes to Nebo.
It comes to Beth-diblathaim.
It comes to Kiriathaim.
It comes to Beth-gamul.
It comes to Beth-meon.
It comes to Kerioth.
It comes to Bozrah.
It comes to all the towns of Moab.
It reaches towns that are far away.
It reaches towns that are near.
passages.original: וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט בָּ֖א אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֶל־ חֹל֥וֹן וְאֶל־ יַ֖הְצָה וְעַל־ מוֹפָעַת׃ וְעַל־ דִּיב֣וֹן וְעַל־ נְב֔וֹ וְעַל־ בֵּ֖ית דִּבְלָתָֽיִם׃ וְעַ֧ל קִרְיָתַ֛יִם וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית גָּמ֖וּל וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית מְעֽוֹן׃ וְעַל־ קְרִיּ֖וֹת וְעַל־ בָּצְרָ֑ה וְעַ֗ל כָּל־ עָרֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב הָרְחֹק֖וֹת וְהַקְּרֹבֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The horn of Moab has been cut off, and his arm is broken,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
Moab is a nation.
Moab was proud and strong.
God has cut off the horn of Moab.
God has broken the arm of Moab.
passages.original: נִגְדְּעָה֙ קֶ֣רֶן מוֹאָ֔ב וּזְרֹע֖וֹ נִשְׁבָּ֑רָה נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Make him drunk, because he has magnified himself against the LORD; so Moab will wallow in his own vomit, and he will also become a laughingstock.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab has become proud against the LORD.
Make Moab drunk.
Moab will wallow in his own vomit.
Moab will become a laughingstock.
passages.original: הַשְׁכִּירֻ֕הוּ כִּ֥י עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּ֑יל וְסָפַ֤ק מוֹאָב֙ בְּקִיא֔וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לִשְׂחֹ֖ק גַּם־ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Was not Israel your object of ridicule? Was he ever found among thieves? For whenever you speak of him you shake your head.
passages.sermon:
Israel is the nation God chose.
You made Israel an object of ridicule.
You mocked Israel.
Israel was not found among thieves.
Israel did not act like a thief.
Every time you spoke about Israel, you shook your head.
You showed scorn for Israel with your words and actions.
passages.original: וְאִ֣ם׀ ל֣וֹא הַשְּׂחֹ֗ק הָיָ֤ה לְךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־ בְּגַנָּבִ֖ים נִמְצָאָה כִּֽי־ מִדֵּ֧י דְבָרֶ֥יךָ בּ֖וֹ תִּתְנוֹדָֽד׃

passages.text: Abandon the towns and settle among the rocks, O dwellers of Moab! Be like a dove that nests at the mouth of a cave.
passages.sermon:
The people of Moab live in Moab.
God speaks to the people of Moab.
God tells them to leave their towns.
God tells them to live among the rocks.
God says, "Be like a dove."
A dove makes its nest at the mouth of a cave.
God wants the people of Moab to be like this dove.
passages.original: עִזְב֤וּ עָרִים֙ וְשִׁכְנ֣וּ בַּסֶּ֔לַע יֹשְׁבֵ֖י מוֹאָ֑ב וִֽהְי֣וּ כְיוֹנָ֔ה תְּקַנֵּ֖ן בְּעֶבְרֵ֥י פִי־ פָֽחַת׃

passages.text: We have heard of Moab’s pomposity, his exceeding pride and conceit, his proud arrogance and haughtiness of heart.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab is very proud.
We have heard about Moab’s pride.
Moab is extremely arrogant.
Moab is full of conceit.
Moab has great self-importance.
Moab’s heart is lifted up with haughtiness.
passages.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן־ מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּאֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד גָּבְה֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ וְרֻ֥ם לִבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I know his insolence,” declares the LORD, “but it is futile. His boasting is as empty as his deeds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD knows Moab’s insolence.
Moab acts with pride and arrogance.
The LORD says Moab’s pride is useless.
Moab’s boasting means nothing.
Moab’s actions are empty.
Moab’s deeds do not match his words.
passages.original: אֲנִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה עֶבְרָת֖וֹ וְלֹא־ כֵ֑ן בַּדָּ֖יו לֹא־ כֵ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: Therefore I will wail for Moab; I will cry out for all of Moab; I will moan for the men of Kir-heres.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation known for pride and arrogance.
God sees Moab’s sin and coming judgment.
Therefore, I will wail for Moab.
I will cry out for all the people of Moab.
I will moan for the men of Kir-heres.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ עַל־ מוֹאָ֣ב אֲיֵלִ֔יל וּלְמוֹאָ֥ב כֻּלֹּ֖ה אֶזְעָ֑ק אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י קִֽיר־ חֶ֖רֶשׂ יֶהְגֶּֽה׃

passages.text: I will weep for you, O vine of Sibmah, more than I weep for Jazer. Your tendrils have extended to the sea; they reach even to Jazer. The destroyer has descended on your summer fruit and grape harvest.
passages.sermon:
God speaks through the prophet.
God addresses the vine of Sibmah.
God says, "I will weep for you, O vine of Sibmah."
God says, "I will weep for you more than I weep for Jazer."
Your tendrils have spread far.
Your tendrils have reached the sea.
Your tendrils have reached all the way to Jazer.
A destroyer has come.
The destroyer has attacked your summer fruit.
The destroyer has attacked your grape harvest.
passages.original: מִבְּכִ֨י יַעְזֵ֤ר אֶבְכֶּה־ לָּךְ֙ הַגֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה נְטִֽישֹׁתַ֙יִךְ֙ עָ֣בְרוּ יָ֔ם עַ֛ד יָ֥ם יַעְזֵ֖ר נָגָ֑עוּ עַל־ קֵיצֵ֥ךְ וְעַל־ בְּצִירֵ֖ךְ שֹׁדֵ֥ד נָפָֽל׃

passages.text: Joy and gladness are removed from the orchard and from the fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy; their shouts are not for joy.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Moab.
God removes joy and gladness from the orchards.
God removes joy and gladness from the land of Moab.
God stops the flow of wine from the winepresses.
No one treads the winepresses with joyful shouts.
Their shouts are not shouts of joy.
passages.original: וְנֶאֶסְפָ֨ה שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִ֛יל מִכַּרְמֶ֖ל וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב וְיַ֙יִן֙ מִיקָבִ֣ים הִשְׁבַּ֔תִּי לֹֽא־ יִדְרֹ֣ךְ הֵידָ֔ד הֵידָ֖ד לֹ֥א הֵידָֽד׃

passages.text: There is a cry from Heshbon to Elealeh; they raise their voices to Jahaz, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim have dried up.
passages.sermon:
The people of Moab cry out.
Their cry begins in Heshbon.
It continues to Elealeh.
They raise their voices in Jahaz.
Their voices travel from Zoar to Horonaim.
They also cry out in Eglath-shelishiyah.
Even the waters of Nimrim have dried up.
The land suffers because there is no water.
passages.original: מִזַּעֲקַ֨ת חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן עַד־ אֶלְעָלֵ֗ה עַד־ יַ֙הַץ֙ נָתְנ֣וּ קוֹלָ֔ם מִצֹּ֙עַר֙ עַד־ חֹ֣רֹנַ֔יִם עֶגְלַ֖ת שְׁלִֽשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֚י גַּם־ מֵ֣י נִמְרִ֔ים לִמְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יִהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: In Moab, declares the LORD, I will bring an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about Moab.
The LORD says, “I will act in Moab.”
I will stop the people in Moab.
These people go up to the high places.
They offer sacrifices there.
They burn incense to their gods.
I will bring all this to an end.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י לְמוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה מַעֲלֶ֣ה בָמָ֔ה וּמַקְטִ֖יר לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: Therefore My heart laments like a flute for Moab; it laments like a flute for the men of Kir-heres, because the wealth they acquired has perished.
passages.sermon:
God speaks through the prophet.
God feels deep sorrow for Moab.
God’s heart mourns for Moab.
God’s sorrow sounds like the music of a flute.
God also mourns for the men of Kir-heres.
God’s heart mourns for them like a flute.
God mourns because their wealth is gone.
The things they worked for have perished.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֞ן לִבִּ֤י לְמוֹאָב֙ כַּחֲלִלִ֣ים יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְלִבִּי֙ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י קִֽיר־ חֶ֔רֶשׂ כַּחֲלִילִ֖ים יֶהֱמֶ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֛ן יִתְרַ֥ת עָשָׂ֖ה אָבָֽדוּ׃

passages.text: For every head is shaved and every beard is clipped; on every hand is a gash, and around every waist is sackcloth.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Moab.
Every person in Moab has a shaved head.
Every person in Moab has a clipped beard.
Every hand in Moab has a gash.
Every waist in Moab has sackcloth.
passages.original: כִּ֤י כָל־ רֹאשׁ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְכָל־ זָקָ֖ן גְּרֻעָ֑ה עַ֤ל כָּל־ יָדַ֙יִם֙ גְּדֻדֹ֔ת וְעַל־ מָתְנַ֖יִם שָֽׂק׃

passages.text: On all the rooftops of Moab and in the public squares, everyone is mourning; for I have shattered Moab like an unwanted jar,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD has judged Moab.
Moab is a nation.
Moab’s people mourn everywhere.
They mourn on every rooftop in Moab.
They mourn in every public square in Moab.
No one is joyful.
The LORD has broken Moab.
The LORD broke Moab like a jar that no one wants.
The LORD declares this.
passages.original: עַ֣ל כָּל־ גַּגּ֥וֹת מוֹאָ֛ב וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶ֖יהָ כֻּלֹּ֣ה מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי־ שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי אֶת־ מוֹאָ֗ב כִּכְלִ֛י אֵֽין־ חֵ֥פֶץ בּ֖וֹ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “How shattered it is! How they wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule and horror to all those around him.”
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab is now shattered.
The people of Moab wail loudly.
Moab has turned his back.
Moab feels deep shame.
Everyone around Moab sees him.
They ridicule Moab.
They see Moab as an object of horror.
passages.original: אֵ֥יךְ חַ֙תָּה֙ הֵילִ֔ילוּ אֵ֛יךְ הִפְנָה־ עֹ֥רֶף מוֹאָ֖ב בּ֑וֹשׁ וְהָיָ֥ה מוֹאָ֛ב לִשְׂחֹ֥ק וְלִמְחִתָּ֖ה לְכָל־ סְבִיבָֽיו׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, an eagle swoops down and spreads his wings against Moab.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says these words.
Look at what happens.
An eagle flies swiftly.
The eagle spreads its wings wide.
The eagle comes against Moab.
passages.original: כִּי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה כַנֶּ֖שֶׁר יִדְאֶ֑ה וּפָרַ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖יו אֶל־ מוֹאָֽב׃

passages.text: Kirioth has been taken, and the strongholds seized. In that day the heart of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
passages.sermon:
Kirioth has been captured.
The strongholds have been seized.
On that day, the warriors of Moab will lose courage.
Their hearts will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
passages.original: נִלְכְּדָה֙ הַקְּרִיּ֔וֹת וְהַמְּצָד֖וֹת נִתְפָּ֑שָׂה וְֽ֠הָיָה לֵ֞ב גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כְּלֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה׃

passages.text: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because he vaunted himself against the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Moab will be destroyed.
Moab will no longer be a people.
Moab exalted himself against the LORD.
Moab acted with pride against the LORD.
Because of this, the LORD will destroy Moab.
passages.original: וְנִשְׁמַ֥ד מוֹאָ֖ב מֵעָ֑ם כִּ֥י עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּֽיל׃

passages.text: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of Moab,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the people of Moab.
You live in Moab.
Terror waits for you.
A pit waits for you.
A snare waits for you.
passages.original: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֛יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Whoever flees the panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For I will bring upon Moab the year of their punishment,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about Moab.
Moab is a nation that has sinned against the LORD.
Anyone in Moab who runs from terror will fall into a pit.
Anyone who climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare.
The LORD will bring a year of punishment upon Moab.
The LORD has declared this.
passages.original: הַנִּיס מִפְּנֵ֤י הַפַּ֙חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־ הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעֹלֶה֙ מִן־ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־ אָבִ֨יא אֵלֶ֧יהָ אֶל־ מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Those who flee will stand helpless in Heshbon’s shadow, because fire has gone forth from Heshbon and a flame from within Sihon. It devours the foreheads of Moab and the skulls of the sons of tumult.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about Moab.
People try to escape danger.
They stand in the shadow of Heshbon.
They have no strength left.
Fire comes out from Heshbon.
A flame comes from inside Sihon.
The fire burns the edges of Moab.
It destroys the heads of the sons of uproar.
passages.original: בְּצֵ֥ל חֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עָמְד֖וּ מִכֹּ֣חַ נָסִ֑ים כִּֽי־ אֵ֞שׁ יָצָ֣א מֵחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן וְלֶֽהָבָה֙ מִבֵּ֣ין סִיח֔וֹן וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ פְּאַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְקָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished; for your sons have been taken into exile and your daughters have gone into captivity.
passages.sermon:
Moab is a nation.
Chemosh is the god of Moab.
The LORD speaks to Moab.
The LORD says, “Woe to you, Moab!”
The people who worship Chemosh have perished.
Your sons have been taken away into exile.
Your daughters have gone into captivity.
passages.original: אוֹי־ לְךָ֣ מוֹאָ֔ב אָבַ֖ד עַם־ כְּמ֑וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ לֻקְּח֤וּ בָנֶ֙יךָ֙ בַּשֶּׁ֔בִי וּבְנֹתֶ֖יךָ בַּשִּׁבְיָֽה׃

passages.text: Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity,” declares the LORD. Here ends the judgment on Moab.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD promises to act in the future.
In the last days, the LORD will restore Moab from captivity.
The LORD will bring Moab back from exile.
This is the end of the LORD’s judgment on Moab.
passages.original: וְשַׁבְתִּ֧י שְׁבוּת־ מוֹאָ֛ב בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה עַד־ הֵ֖נָּה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט מוֹאָֽב׃ס
